_comment: Per-trail settings for tools/build_geo.py. Points are [lat, lon] (WGS84). 'via' points pull the route onto the bank/variant the trail-data mileages follow; each is snapped to the nearest edge of the source network, so put them on the path itself, well away from the other bank. 'startLandmark'/'endLandmark' name the trail-data landmarks the route line begins and ends at, when the source line doesn't cover the whole trail (defaults: first and last landmark).

via.label: Greenwich, south bank by the Cutty Sark
Bankside, south bank by Tate Modern
South Bank by the London Eye
Bishop's Park, Fulham, north bank (Putney to Hammersmith)
